description: Buy a fixed dollar amount of one token or tokenized stock on a schedule.

TOKEN.description: the token as the owner named it — a ticker (VIRTUAL, ETH, TSLA) or the address they gave; the title shows it. A crypto ticker also needs ADDRESS and CHAIN_ID from token-search, and when several matches fit, the owner picks one from a card showing each match's name, chain and address. A tokenized stock is its ticker alone

ADDRESS.description: the contract address of a crypto TOKEN named by ticker, on CHAIN_ID (a Solana mint verbatim). Not set for an address TOKEN, for ETH, BNB or SOL, or for a tokenized stock

CHAIN_ID.description: the chain of a crypto token or coin, as a numeric id: Base 8453, Ethereum 1, BSC 56, Arbitrum 42161, Robinhood 4663, Solana 1151111081099710. A tokenized stock takes none — the rail buys it on the venue that returns the most shares

SIZING.description: dollar-cost averaging is fixed-size by definition
